prompt: This test always passes even when it should fail. Why?
choices: The catch block swallows the exception — the test passes without asserting anything
JUnit ignores tests that throw exceptions
explanation: The ArithmeticException is caught and silently ignored. No assertion is ever reached. JUnit sees no failure and marks the test as passed. Fix: use assertThrows(ArithmeticException.class, () -> 10 / 0) or let the exception propagate.
